text: [calm, natural narrator voice] On the left: how fast the magnetic field changes, at each point. First term on the right: the flow carries the field along and stretches it, like the threads. Second term: diffusion smudges it, at a pace set by the magnetic diffusivity. A poor conductor smudges fast. Stretching against smudging: the whole race, in one line.
